title: Oyakodon (chicken and egg rice bowl)
steps: Wash the rice and cook it covered with 170 ml water for 12 minutes.
Slice the onion and cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Bring the stock to the boil with the soy sauce and sugar, cook the onion in it for 3 minutes, add the chicken and simmer for 6 minutes.
Lightly beat the eggs, pour them over and cook covered for 1–2 minutes so they stay soft.
Spoon over the rice and sprinkle with spring onion.
